Guideline Name 
Hemangeol (propranolol oral solution)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
6/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Hemangeol  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - One of the following:  
 
 1.1 Patient is 10 years of age or younger  
 
OR 


=== PDF PAGE 771 ===
Page 771 
 
 1.2 All of the following:  
 
  1.2.1 Patient is greater than 10 years of age  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.2 Diagnosis of proliferating infantile hemangioma  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.3 Prescriber provides a reason or special circumstance the patient cannot use generic 
propranolol oral solution  
Notes  
Note: PA is required for patients greater than 10 years of age
